hooks.command: if [ "${PRODUCT_TREE_SESSION_HOOK_DISABLED:-}" = "1" ]; then echo '{}'; else SPX_BIN="${SPX_BIN:-spx}"; command -v "$SPX_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$SPX_BIN" hook run session-start || echo '{}'; fi

if [ "${PRODUCT_TREE_SESSION_HOOK_DISABLED:-}" != "1" ] && [ -r "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/understand/compact-recovery.md" ]; then while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do printf '%s\n' "$line"; done < "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/understand/compact-recovery.md"; fi; exit 0
